title: oldenlandia hookeri
intro: Oldenlandia hookeri, commonly known as Hooker's mint or Hooker's oldenlandia, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is a medicinal herb used in traditional medicine, primarily in Asia, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Oldenlandia hookeri include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving coughs, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
